svg.aria-label: Perfboard layout seen from the front: every part, link and wire on a 16 by 22 hole board
svg.text: Perfboard layout, seen from the front (the ring side)
16 × 22 holes at 2.54 mm (40.6 × 55.9 mm), drawn to scale. Dashed outlines are parts on the back, with only their pins coming through.
Only button 1, the ring, the resistors and the diode are on the front. The XIAO is on the back, face down, so its pin order is mirrored.
battery on the back, from here up
on the front, in the middle of the ring
for Q2 (R3 1 kΩ is beside the XIAO pins)
four dotted teal circles: keep them clear
Solder bridge or bare link on the front, hole to hole. Black is ground, red is 3V3, other colors are signals.
The same, on the back (the two by button 1).
Thin insulated wire on the back, under the battery: wires A, B and C. Keep them from crossing.
Pin or leg of a part on the back (XIAO, button 2, Q1, Q2), soldered on the front. The white one is D6, cut off before mounting.
Lead of a part on the front, soldered on the back.
End of wire A, B or C or the jumper. Numbered circles are holes for wires that leave the board.
Pink dotted circles: where the ring sits. No part or link goes under it on the front; only its own three wires run there.
